section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the commandment to build a Sanctuary applies to all Temples, and that the main drawing down of the Divine Presence is achieved through service beyond measure and limitation, which will build the Third Temple.
section.t: And it is known,
that the commandment "And they shall make Me a Sanctuary" applies also to the Sanctuary,
the First Temple, the Second Temple,
and also the Third Holy Temple that will be built speedily in our days.
And from this it is understood,
that just as the drawing down of the main Shechinah in the Mishkan was through the service that is above measure and limitation,
the folly of holiness that is above reason and understanding,
so too is it regarding the drawing down of the main Shechinah in the Holy Temple,
that this is accomplished through the service of the folly of holiness that is above measure and limitation.
For through our actions and our service during the time of exile in a manner of the folly of holiness that is above reason and understanding,
through this, "And they shall make Me,"
the making of the Third Holy Temple that will be built speedily in our days,
which will be even more elevated than the Mishkan and the First and Second Temples,
"The Sanctuary, My Lord, which Your hands established."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that Israel is called the "Hosts of G-d" because their service must be like an army, without calculations based on reason and understanding, but with the folly of holiness.
section.t: And this is what Israel is called by the name "Hosts of G-d"
throughout all the generations,
for each and every Jew is a soldier in the hosts of G-d,
who goes out as an army to war,
to conquer the world and make it a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He.
And this that Israel is called by the name "Hosts of G-d"
(specifically "hosts")
is to indicate,
that their service must be in a manner that they do not take into account calculations according to reason and understanding,
the folly of holiness that is above reason and understanding,
similar to a literal army.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that just as a king spends all his treasuries to win a war, so too G-d gives the hosts of Israel the supernal treasures in a manner of squandering, without calculation, because the root of victory is in the innerness of Kesser, where no calculations exist.
section.t: And the Maamar continues,
that just as in a physical war,
in order to win the war, the king spends all the treasuries that were amassed over many years from generation to generation,
for although in the ordinary way, not only are they not used
(even for a great need)
but furthermore,
they are hidden and concealed from the eye of every beholder,
nevertheless, in order to defeat the opponent,
not only are the treasuries used, but they are even squandered,
for squandering is above calculation, measure, and limitation,
and the reason for this is that victory is rooted in the essence of the soul of that place
(in the essence of the soul)
where no calculations apply,
so too is it above,
that in order for the hosts of G-d to win the war,
to conquer the world and make it a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
they are given the aspect of the supernal treasure,
and moreover,
the giving of the treasures to them is in a manner of squandering,
above calculation.
And although even in giving
(in the ordinary way)
they said,
"Whoever gives, gives with a generous eye,"
nevertheless, even a "generous eye" is a description of measure and limitation,
but when the giving is in a manner of squandering,
there are no limitations in it.
And the reason for this
(that in order for the hosts of G-d to win the war,
they are given the treasures and in a manner of squandering)
is,
because the root of victory is in the innerness of Kesser,
for there
(in the innerness of Kesser)
no calculations apply.
And although the giving of the treasures in a manner of squandering is through the ministers and commanders of the war,
the Nesi'im of Israel in each generation,
up to the Nasi of our generation, the Baal HaHilula,
nevertheless, the main intention in this is that the treasures be drawn down and given to the men of valor,
the hosts of G-d,
through whom the victory is actually accomplished.
And this is also that the victory that will be through the service of the hosts of G-d
(in the Third Holy Temple)
is an eternal victory
("G-d shall reign forever and ever"),
for since the empowerment for their service is from the innerness of Kesser,
for in the innerness of Kesser the matter of changes does not apply,
therefore also the service of the hosts of G-d is with strong force without changes,
and consequently, also the victory through this service is eternal, in which cessation and change do not apply.
